description: Full status of a published site — the one call to confirm a publish landed and inspect it. Identify the site by token, OR by name + project_key. Runs a real server-side HTTP probe (live_http) so you get a definitive "is it serving?" answer even while the fresh DNS has not propagated to you yet — prefer this over fetching the URL directly right after publishing. Also returns the current version, content_hash (to detect drift from what you published), size, file_count, source, and the claim/expiry state.

name.description: Site name (alternative to token; pair with project_key).

project_key.description: The project_key you published the named site with (>=16 chars).

token.description: The manage token returned when the site was published.

name: get_site_status

claim.description: If unclaimed: how to keep it forever (free) — { time_left, seconds_left, claimable_until, claim_url }. Surface claim_url to the user so they can own the site before it expires.

content_hash.description: Hash of the live content — compare to your publish content_hash to confirm the live site matches what you sent.

expiring_soon.description: True when unclaimed and < 6h from expiry — prompt the user to claim it NOW so it is not auto-removed.

last_published.description: ISO-8601 time of the most recent deploy.

live_http.description: Server-side HTTP probe of the live URL: { ok, status_code, ms, final_url, error }. ok=true means it is genuinely serving right now.

source.description: The attribution tag it was published with.

total_bytes.description: Total uncompressed size of the site.

title: Get site status
